units.source_text: 嘎尔看到我默不出声，可能是意识到我心怀同情，

en.t: Seeing that I had fallen silent, Gar perhaps realized that I felt sympathy for him,

units.source_text: 趾高气扬提起大肚皮说：“嗐，《卟—弗日报》的记者们也不全都支持工人。

en.t: he thrust out his big belly with an air of triumph and said, "Well now, not all the reporters at the Poo-Foo Daily support the workers.

units.source_text: 我们河童至少优先支持我们自己，其他都靠边站呢……

en.t: We kappas at least support ourselves first; everything else can step aside...

units.source_text: 更麻烦的是，还有操纵我嘎尔的呢。

en.t: What is still more troublesome is that there is even someone manipulating me, Gar.
Who do you think that is?

units.source_text: 那便是我的妻子——美丽迷人的嘎尔夫人。”

en.t: It is my wife, the beautiful and charming Mrs. Gar."
